candidates.why_maybe_new: Expansion of Texas Eastern with no row of its own. About 11.8 miles total (about 19 km), 36 in, +125 MMcf/d, in service 2028. Data center tie is indirect (power plant for Amazon-area campuses), so confidence is medium.

candidates.name: Tiger Pipeline Franklin Farms Lateral
candidates.to: Entergy Louisiana Richland Parish power plants

evidence.note: Energy Transfer and Entergy Louisiana 20-year agreement for a 12-mile lateral, up to 1 Bcf/d, to supply plants for the north Louisiana data center load

candidates.why_maybe_new: New lateral, not the existing P5849 21-mile Tiger expansion. Length 12 miles per Energy Transfer; a secondary post cites 13.24 miles at FERC (not verified). Feeds plants for Meta's Richland Parish campus per EIA notes.
